messages:
maya-sales: ACME signed LOI and needs our SOC 2 report + a temporary attestation (bridge) for their vendor review. They asked for redacted artifacts before NDA. Need by Friday EOD. Anyone handled this?

chris-se: We require a signed NDA for the full report. For POCs we can provide a redacted PDF + bridge letter. I can draft attestation if legal OK.

julian-sec: NDA first is preferred. We have SOC 2 Type II for 2024 (Hosted API). Bridge should state scope, period, encryption, KMS, access controls, logging, IR. I can write the security paragraph.

tara-legal: NDA is required for full report. Bridge letter template exists. Signatory usually CISO or Legal Ops. I'll pre-approve short attestations for non-sensitive items. Send customer name and scope.

maya-sales: Customer: AcmeCorp (raj@acme). Scope: Hosted API only. I'm sending NDA link now.

chris-se: Proposed bridge wording:

"Scope: Redwood Hosted API (no customer-managed/private deployments)
Period: Jan 1 2024 - Dec 31 2024
Controls: logical access, encryption at rest & in transit, KMS key management, logging & retention, incident response & vulnerability management
Limitations: redacted attachments; full report requires executed NDA"

OK?

julian-sec: Add least-privilege note and that transient PII isn't stored beyond request lifecycle. Also include patch cadence; avoid naming auditor without compliance signoff.

tara-legal: Approved w/ change: don't name auditor in bridge. I'll draft NDA email and bridge template. I can sign or route to CISO.

maya-sales: I pinged raj for signature. Tara, can you draft bridge and loop chris/julian for tech lines? 24-48h turnaround preferred after NDA.

tara-legal: Will draft within 24h after header details. Chris/Julian DM me technical snippets. :+1:

compliance-bot: Uploaded redacted report: https://secure.redwood.example/soc2/acme-redacted-1769443210.pdf (access gated by NDA) :lock:

maya-sales: Thanks all. I'll update ACME when NDA signed.

chris-se: Dropping one-paragraph blurb to Tara's DM now.

julian-sec: Sending log retention and KMS provider (AWS KMS) details in DM.

maya-sales: Closing loop when NDA arrives. :handshake:
